title: Neonatal Infection Surveillance Database
summary: NeonIN is a is a neonatal infection surveillance database which will facilitate active surveillance for bacterial infections through a network of neonatal units, using standardised definitions, proformas and microbiological techniques. The centralised and secure web-based database will allow real-time entry of data and rapid and timely analysis of results.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infants on participating Neonatal Units who have an episode of infection with a positive culture

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
